sn47.20:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati sedakaṃ nāma sumbhānaṃ nigamo.
sn47.20:2.1: “seyyathāpi bhikkhave, janapadakalyāṇī, “janapadakalyāṇī”ti kho bhikkhave, mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sn47.20:2.2: sā kho panassa janapadakalyāṇī paramapāsāvinī nacce, paramapāsāvinī gīte.
sn47.20:2.3: janapadakalyāṇī naccati gāyatīti kho bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sn47.20:2.4: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo.
sn47.20:2.6: ayaṃ te ambhopurisa, samatittiko telapatto antarena mahāsamayaṃ antarena janapadakalyāṇiyā parihāretabbo.
sn47.20:2.7: puriso ceko te ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati.
sn47.20:2.8: yattheva naṃ thokampi chaḍḍessati tattheva te siro pātessatīti.
sn47.20:2.10: api nu so puriso amuṃ telapattaṃ amanasikaritvā bahiddhā pamādaṃ āhareyyāti?
sn47.20:3.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
sn47.20:3.3: “samatittiko telapattoti kho bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.
sn47.20:3.5: kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti.”
